purpose: Freeze an obvious-below-local-baseline matched micro-audit before computing local path evidence.

baseline.model_relative_scope: same weights, classifier guidance, ancestral sampler, resolution, and ImageNet class

selection_constraints.required_interpretation: discovery candidate only; relative_bad remains not_evaluated until the frozen v3 two-reviewer protocol is completed

matched_seed_blocks.candidate_reason: The subject is an amorphous glossy red field with no stable strawberry boundary, calyx, or fruit geometry; it is plainly below the class-949 cohort's typical recognizable fruit samples.
Multiple panda-like heads and bodies fuse into an incoherent topology; this is plainly below the class-388 cohort's typical single-panda structure.
The dog's face, muzzle, neck, and torso collapse into smeared geometry with no stable body boundary; this is plainly below the class-207 cohort's typical dog samples.

analysis_rule: Within each seed block, first ask whether the evidence distinguishes the preselected class-specific failure from the two outputs generated with the identical Gaussian innovation stream. Do not pool these three candidates into a TPR estimate.
